noteGrp.note: A Syriac liturgical hymn attributed to Balai and transmitted among prayers of the departed. Connolly’s presentation does not supply this item with a distinctive individual title (listed as "Another"), so the present record uses the descriptive headword “Untitled Hymn.” Connolly marks this as VII.
